messages.content: 你能使用 get_stock_prices 函數來檢索蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價嗎？。

function.name: get_stock_prices
function.description: Retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

companies.description: List of companies to retrieve stock prices for.

duration.description: Time duration to retrieve stock prices for. E.g., '1 week', '2 weeks', '1 month', etc.

message.reasoning: The user wants to use get_stock_prices function to retrieve stock prices for Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Tesla for durations 1 week, 2 weeks, 3 weeks, 1 month. The function signature expects companies: string[] and duration: string. But we need to retrieve multiple durations. The function only accepts one duration at a time. We could call the function multiple times with each duration. But the user asked "能使用 get_stock_prices 函数来检索...分别在1周、2周、3周和1个月的时间范围内的股价吗？" They want to get stock prices for each company for each duration. We can interpret that they want to get data for each company for each duration. We can call the function four times, each with the same companies list but different duration. Or we can call it once per company per duration. But the function only accepts companies array and duration string. So we can call it four times: one for each duration. That will return data for all four companies for that duration. Then we can combine results. So we need to call get_stock_prices with companies ["Apple", "Microsoft", "Amazon", "Tesla"] and duration "1 week". Then again with "2 weeks", "3 weeks", "1 month". We'll produce four calls. The user didn't specify the format of output. We can just return the results. We'll call the function four times.
